Next Steps

Print Pre-Paid Shipping Label and Quote

Include a copy of your quote in your shipped box.

Protect & Pack Items

Wrap your items in protective wrapping and place in appropriately sized box. Double check to make sure all items are included.

Ship Your Package

Take your boxed gear with label attached to a FedEx drop off location. Make sure to keep your receipt and your tracking reference number.

Get Paid

Trade-In Credit will be sent to your inbox.

What Happens Next

Our evaluators inspect gear in the order received. Evaluation takes up to 3 business days, and we'll email you progress updates.

If the assessed condition differs from your quote, we'll contact you to accept the revision or have your items shipped back — free.
